Add clearance, reduce mate travel, move the geometry so the swept pose stays collision-free, or pass { ignore: [['CAN-interface-PCB', 'CAN-J2']] } as the SECOND argument to solvedModel({}, { ignore: ... }) if this overlap is genuinely intended. If you recently patched connectors, check for leftover duplicate parts before tweaking geometry.
